summary.text: Farrah Chaichi is a Democratic state representative from District 35 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
She appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with Democratic and Working Families Party nominations.

paragraphs.text: Farrah Chaichi was born in and lives in Beaverton, Oregon, and earned a degree in criminal justice and political science.
She volunteered with the Beaverton Human Rights Advisory Commission.
